frequency/tones.title: Tone-frequency sweep
frequency/tones.description: 20–40 kHz in 125 Hz steps; target −36 dBFS RMS; +10 dB input SNR; three directions × three seeds. More than six samples per N256 bin spacing; never just selected-bin centers.

level/quiet.title: Weak-signal level
level/quiet.description: −100 to −20 dBFS RMS in 5 dB steps, no added noise: isolates PCM quantization and integer-map extinction, not microphone sensitivity. Three bands × two directions × three seeds.

noise/snr.title: Background noise
noise/snr.description: −30 to +20 dB SNR in 5 dB steps. Source −46 dBFS RMS, avoiding ADC overload at the highest noise level; independent, full-PCM-band white channel noise. SNR is nominal, before bin selection; three source bands × two directions × three seeds.

fov/azimuth.title: Field of view · azimuth
fov/azimuth.description: −29.5° to +29.5°; other angle 0.7°, avoiding only on-grid tests. Target −36 dBFS RMS, +10 dB SNR; three bands × three seeds.

fov/elevation.title: Field of view · elevation
fov/elevation.description: −29.5° to +29.5°; other angle 0.7°, avoiding only on-grid tests. Target −36 dBFS RMS, +10 dB SNR; three bands × three seeds.

multiple/separation.title: Two sources · separation
multiple/separation.description: Two independent broadband sources, centered near boresight; stronger source −36 dBFS RMS and noise −46 dBFS. Separation varies at equal strength; imbalance varies at fixed 12° separation. Distinct local peaks must each match within 3° and lie above −12 dB. Three bands × three seeds.

multiple/imbalance.title: Two sources · imbalance
multiple/imbalance.description: Two independent broadband sources, centered near boresight; stronger source −36 dBFS RMS and noise −46 dBFS. Separation varies at equal strength; imbalance varies at fixed 12° separation. Distinct local peaks must each match within 3° and lie above −12 dB. Three bands × three seeds.

pulse/width.title: Short pulses
pulse/width.description: 50, 100, 200, 400, 800 and 1,600 µs Gaussian-envelope synthetic 20–40 kHz bursts, centered in BOTH observation windows. Peak levels −30/−50/−65 dBFS at the 30-mic reference array; independent noise −70 dBFS. Two directions × three seeds. This tests captured bursts, not the probability that a sparse snapshot catches an event.

interference/tone_frequency.title: Tonal interference · frequency sweep
interference/tone_frequency.description: Rear tone swept from 20–40 kHz in 125 Hz steps. Each point averages nine target/interferer levels (−20 to +20 dB), two target directions and three seeds: 54 cases per frequency. Target is 20–40 kHz broadband at −36 dBFS RMS; independent noise −46 dBFS. Rear source [0.15, 0, −0.30] m; other conditions fixed.

interference/tone_sir.title: Tonal interference · strength sweep
interference/tone_sir.description: The same swept-tone cases regrouped by strength. Each point averages all 161 interferer frequencies, two target directions and three seeds. This is a second view of the same tests, not an extra contribution to the score.

interference/broadband.title: Broadband rear-interference check
interference/broadband.description: Synthetic coherent point interferer at [0.15, 0, −0.30] m, behind the array, with spherical delays and 1/r level differences. Target −36 dBFS RMS, noise −46 dBFS. Interferer level is referenced to RMS on the native 30-mic array. This is an in-band drone interference stress proxy, not recorded propeller noise. Two target directions × three seeds.

mismatch/temperature.title: Model mismatch · temperature
mismatch/temperature.description: One factor at a time: temperature −10…40°C (c = 331.3 + 0.606T), channel gain σ 0…3 dB, channel delay σ 0…2 µs, or range 0.5…35 m. Fixed steering uses 343 m/s and far-field focus. Source −36 dBFS RMS and +10 dB SNR; three bands × three seeds, target (13.4°, −7.1°). Range holds received RMS constant to isolate wavefront curvature: it is NOT a detection-range prediction.

controls/noise_only.title: Noise-only control
controls/noise_only.description: Noise-only maps at −70/−46/−26 dBFS, 20 independent seeds. No localization score or radar contribution. Without a detector threshold, any nonzero map still has a strongest pixel.

pass_rule: Nonzero map, strongest pixel within 3° of the source (or two distinct matched peaks within 3° and above −12 dB for a pair), and weakest target neighborhood at least 3 dB above the strongest pixel more than 9° from every true source. No operational detector is implied.
score_weighting: Each category averages its scored families equally. Rear interference is 50% broadband check and 50% uniformly frequency-weighted tonal sweep; the strength projection is excluded. Overall is the arithmetic mean of eight category scores.

assumptions.normalization: Common 512-sample scene, centered candidate windows. Steady-source RMS and pulse peak referenced to the 30-mic array, held fixed across arrays. No image normalization is used in scores.
assumptions.baseline: Source −36 dBFS RMS, independent white channel noise −46 dBFS (+10 dB SNR), except where the tested condition explicitly changes them.

limitations: Synthetic PCM, not PDM or analogue microphone input; no flight data, microphone frequency response, weather absorption, reflections or ADC front-end overload beyond PCM saturation.
Electrical discharge is represented by tones, independent multitone bands and Gaussian-envelope bursts; these are stress probes, not a validated PD waveform distribution.
Radar percentages are coverage of deliberately chosen test ranges, not real-world detection probabilities or sensitivity in SPL.
Steady and burst observation duration differs by candidate; centering bursts isolates captured-event quality. Capture scheduling, overlap and multiwindow accumulation are not simulated.
Noise-only controls have no detection pass/fail because the RTL power map has no operational absent-target decision.
Sweeps are one-factor families with a small set of fixed contexts. They do not cover the full joint space of simultaneous stressors or all deployment conditions.
overall_score_definition: Equal-weight arithmetic mean of all eight category scores, out of 100. Synthetic benchmark summary, not field detection probability.
reference_definition: Float64 samples, full real FFT/complex128, analytic float window and steering, all 53 in-band bins, one N512 window, no input PCM16 rounding or fixed-point truncation. Conventional equal-weight frequency-domain delay-and-sum; no adaptive interference rejection.
input_provenance: Retained cases use the original benchmark recordings. New swept-tone cases have per-variant full-window PCM digests; identical 30-mic layouts share one digest.
rear_frequency_sweep_protocol: Rear-interference score: 50% existing broadband check + 50% uniformly frequency-weighted tonal sweep. The strength projection is not counted again. Other seven radar categories unchanged.
